items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Papa Mud was playing trumpet and Dodds was playing clarinet then.

ctx.x: I guess that was his girlfriend for a while.

Yeah. So after Sugar died, I think if I'm not mistaken, I don't know who was playing trumpet. Well anyhow, no that's right, they got in Mud Carey, that's right. Mud Carey came in there once. That's right. Mud Carey came in there. And Johnny Dodds came up there together. Yeah. I don't know how the mix up come up, but it was at the Dreamland, then the band changed a little. Papa Mud was playing trumpet and Dodds was playing clarinet then. So at the meantime, Papa Mud wanted to take a trip back to New Orleans. So…
